# notMyShell (NMSh)

notMyShell is a terminal frontend that runs on top of a real persistent shell instead of replacing the shell.

Current primary backend:
- zsh

Current primary platform:
- macOS

Primary terminal host during development:
- Ghostty

Core architecture:

Terminal host
→ NMSh frontend
→ persistent real zsh PTY

## Core capabilities

- fixed/persistent bottom input editor
- scrollable command and output history
- semantic syntax highlighting
- submitted commands retain semantic highlighting in history
- multiline editing
- shell-aware autocomplete/completion
- ghost/history suggestions
- real aliases, functions, environment, cwd and shell state
- command lifecycle/activity UI
- passthrough for fullscreen/interactive terminal programs
- /copy
- /history
- /appearance
- /keyboard
- zoxide integration
- Atuin/history bridge where accurate
- fzf/fullscreen passthrough where accurate

## NMSh is NOT

- not a shell replacement
- not a terminal emulator
- not an AI shell
- not a command-by-command subprocess wrapper
- not a Warp clone

## Important architecture files

src/app/TerminalApp.ts
src/shell/ShellSession.ts

src/input/Highlighter.ts
